items.position: Technical Lead & Solutions Architect | Software Application Developer
highlights: Cloud & Full-Stack Architecture: Leadership in the design and development of cloud-native systems using .NET 8, Blazor WebAssembly, Azure Service Bus and Worker Services. Comprehensive Azure infrastructure management (App Service, SQL, VPN Gateway, Entra ID) ensuring high availability, security and cost optimization.

Data Engineering & Analytics: Design and implementation of data ecosystems under Medallion architecture (Bronze–Silver–Gold) on SQL Server. Orchestration of 148+ SSIS packages to transform 70+ sales tables in enterprise Data Lake projects, drastically reducing analytical cycle times for BI teams.

Business Intelligence: End-to-end delivery of BI platforms with Power BI, Python (Streamlit), advanced DAX modeling, DirectQuery and star schema. Solutions deployed for government ministries, banking institutions and retail/logistics companies.

System Modernization: Full migration of legacy on-premise applications to cloud-native architectures on Azure, eliminating obsolete dependencies and enabling multi-device access with guaranteed operational continuity.

Strategic Consulting & Bids: Development of SOWs, technical roadmaps, infrastructure sizing and risk classification by support tier for projects in regulated sectors: banking, government, aviation and telecommunications.
Technical Leadership & Scrum: Direction of agile development squads, executive stakeholder management and strategic alignment between business units and IT teams on high-impact projects.

Full-Stack Development & SaaS Architecture: Design and delivery of comprehensive web solutions for international clients — e-commerce platforms, landing pages and ERP systems. Modern stack: React, Next.js, Angular, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS on frontend; Node.js, Express, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Supabase and Firebase on backend.

MiBoletoni (PaaS/SaaS): End-to-end architecture and Google Cloud deployment of a digital ticketing platform. Integration of payment gateways (Stripe/Fygaro), offline-first QR code access validation, multi-role financial administration panels and secure authentication management.

DevOps, CI/CD & Security: Software lifecycle automation with GitHub Actions targeting Vercel and Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Cloud Build). Docker containerization, SSISDB deployment maintenance and resolution of critical vulnerabilities in Firebase Cloud Storage.

Data Science & Analytics: Advanced analysis with Python (Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn) and Power BI to transform data into strategic insights supporting complex decision-making for clients in sales, finance and operations.

Business Analysis & Process Improvement: Strategic evaluation and implementation of technology solutions aimed at optimizing financial performance. Identification of bottlenecks and design of data-driven workflows to strengthen operational infrastructure.

Data Visualization & BI: Design and implementation of interactive dashboards with critical KPIs in Power BI, enabling measurement of effectiveness and ROI of implemented solutions for strategic decision-making.

Marketing Tech & Digital Analytics: Web development management with CMS (WordPress, Wix Studio). Execution of Technical SEO strategies and full analytics stack integration: Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager and Meta Pixel for precise event and conversion tracking.

Digital Transformation & Oracle APEX: Technical leadership in the development and deployment of enterprise applications with Oracle SQL and Oracle APEX, successfully automating critical operational processes for the Digital Transformation division of one of Central America's leading telecom operators.

SDLC Management & Quality Control: Full software development lifecycle control — architecture diagram design, standardized technical documentation in Confluence and exhaustive supervision of SIT, UAT and QA testing phases to ensure product viability and quality.

Agile & Strategic Alignment: Coordination of cross-functional teams under Scrum and Kanban with Jira. Key technical liaison between business units and IT teams, efficiently translating complex requirements into clear, measurable deliverables.
Core Development & Evolutionary Maintenance: Development and maintenance of information systems for the insurance sector using PL/SQL, Oracle Forms and Oracle Reports.
Transactional Data Management: Administration of large volumes of transactional data ensuring integrity, security and business logic compliance through advanced queries and process optimization.
Insurance policy subscription management and analysis. Operation of specialized underwriting systems and personnel training on GPS technology applied to agricultural policies.
Preventive and corrective hardware maintenance, CCTV system administration and on-site/remote technical support to ensure operational continuity in retail environments.

about.title: Professional Profile
about.description: Cloud Solutions Architect and Technical Lead with 5+ years designing mission-critical digital ecosystems. My multidisciplinary approach merges enterprise software engineering, cloud-native architecture and strategic data analysis to build platforms that don't just work they scale, optimize costs and generate real business impact. I have led end-to-end projects in regulated sectors including banking, government, telecommunications, sales, finance and operations, translating complex requirements into robust, measurable solutions aligned with each organization's strategic objectives.

projects.title: MiBoletoni & Digital Ticketing
projects.description: Complete PaaS platform for digital ticketing management and sales. I designed a scalable architecture that handles real-time traffic spikes. Includes dynamic QR code generation, ticket printing for physical point-of-sale, user auth and roles, payment gateway integration (Fygaro), and a financial admin panel.

projects.title: Properties & Analytics
projects.description: Progressive Web App (PWA) for the real estate sector. Allows agents to manage inventory and users to filter properties with advanced search algorithms. Integrated interactive maps and a price-per-square-meter analysis module.

projects.title: TechServices & IT Solutions
projects.description: High-performance corporate website for a technology services agency. I designed a user experience (UX) centered on conversion and speed. Implemented advanced Semantic SEO practices and image optimization, achieving load times under 1.5s. The modular architecture allows scaling new service sections without technical debt.

projects.title: City Pizzeria
projects.description: E-commerce Single Page Application (SPA). I designed a native centralized state architecture with React 19, optimizing data flow without relying on external libraries. The system integrates a real-time cart engine, dynamic tax calculation (GST) and a 3-stage checkout pipeline with strict validation via controlled forms. Fully responsive interface with React Bootstrap.

projects.title: EmprenFactor — Entrepreneurship Blog
projects.description: Full-stack content platform aimed at Spanish-speaking entrepreneurs. Built with React + Vite, it features a real-time article search engine, dynamic filtering by categories (Finance, Productivity, Digital Marketing, Business Ideas), featured posts section, validated contact form and responsive navigation. Backend powered by Firebase (Firestore + custom security rules). Integrated with Google Search Console for SEO traceability and deployed in production via Vercel.

items.title: Full-Stack Engineering & Web Architecture
items.intro: I design and build high-performance digital platforms from modern SPAs to complex enterprise architectures. Every solution is conceived under Clean Architecture principles, built to scale, maintain, and deliver value from the first deploy.

bullets.label: Frontend & High-Fidelity UI:
bullets.text: Pixel-perfect interfaces with HTML, CSS, React, Next.js, Angular and TypeScript over Tailwind CSS, Shadcn and Bootstrap. Advanced state management with TanStack Query and Zustand. Applications that combine speed, accessibility and executive user experience.

bullets.label: Enterprise Backend:
bullets.text: Robust and scalable APIs with .NET 8 (C#/ASP.NET Core), Spring Boot, Node.js and Express, applying Singleton, Repository and Factory patterns. Integration with Azure Service Bus and Worker Services for event-driven solutions in critical transactions.

bullets.label: QA, Security & Deployment:
bullets.text: Exhaustive testing with Postman and SoapUI. Deployments on Cloudflare, Vercel and Azure App Service with DNS management, SSL/HTTPS and security audits. Proven experience resolving critical vulnerabilities in production environments.

items.title: Cloud Architecture & Scalable Solutions
items.intro: I design mission critical cloud architectures that support high availability, fault tolerance and sustained growth. I translate business requirements into resilient infrastructures on Azure, AWS and Google Cloud optimized for cost, security and performance.

bullets.label: Cloud Architecture & High Availability:
bullets.text: Multi-layer architecture design on Azure (App Service, SQL, Service Bus, VPN Gateway, Entra ID), AWS (EC2, S3, RDS) and GCP (Cloud Run). Event-driven patterns, microservices and serverless solutions for high-demand environments in banking, government, electoral systems and aviation.

bullets.label: Migration & Modernization:
bullets.text: Migration of legacy on-premise systems to cloud-native architectures, eliminating obsolete dependencies and reducing operational costs. Experience in full migrations across regulated sectors with guaranteed operational continuity.

bullets.label: Sizing & Technical Proposals:
bullets.text: Development of architecture proposals, infrastructure sizing and risk classification by support tier. Executive technical documentation for bids and stakeholders in high impact enterprise projects.

items.title: DevOps, CI/CD & Infrastructure as Code
items.intro: I eliminate the friction between code and production. I automate the complete software lifecycle through robust pipelines, containerization and reproducible infrastructure management ensuring continuous, stable and auditable deliveries.

bullets.label: CI/CD Pipelines & Automation:
bullets.text: Continuous delivery cycles with GitHub Actions, Cloud Build and Cloud Run targeting Vercel and Azure. Advanced collaborative workflows with Git/Gitflow in distributed and multidisciplinary teams.

bullets.label: Containerization & Servers:
bullets.text: Standardization with Docker/Compose. Linux server administration (Ubuntu) with Nginx as reverse proxy. Infrastructure as Code with Terraform. From local environment to cloud production and back without friction.

bullets.label: Security & DevSecOps Auditing:
bullets.text: Integration of security practices into the pipeline: vulnerability audits, secrets management and resolution of critical bugs in production environments. SSISDB deployments and ETL package maintenance in enterprise infrastructure.

items.title: Data Intelligence (BI) & Data Engineering
items.intro: I turn scattered data into strategic assets. I design end-to-end data architectures from raw ingestion to the executive dashboard ensuring quality, traceability and analytical speed for informed decision making.

bullets.label: Executive Dashboards & BI:
bullets.text: Interactive dashboards in Power BI with advanced DAX modeling, DirectQuery and star schema. Business KPI-oriented visualizations that shorten managerial decision cycles. Proven experience delivering BI platforms for ministries, banking institutions and retail.

bullets.label: Data Engineering & Medallion Architecture:
bullets.text: Implementation of Data Lakes under the Bronze–Silver–Gold model with SQL Server, SSIS and Python. Orchestration of over 148 ETL packages in enterprise projects. Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Data Warehouse, Data Mart and Big Data environments.

bullets.label: Data Science & Data Applications:
bullets.text: Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Statsmodels) for predictive analysis and financial modeling. Development of data Web Apps with Streamlit and Plotly, deployed in production as decision-support tools for executive teams.

items.title: Strategic Consulting, Project Management & Technical SEO

bullets.label: Agile Project Management:
bullets.text: Leadership of development squads under Scrum and Kanban using Jira, Trello, Planner and Notion. Executive stakeholder management, full SDLC control and alignment between business units and IT teams on high impact projects.

bullets.label: Technical SEO & Web Performance:
bullets.text: Performance audits and Core Web Vitals optimization. Organic positioning strategy with Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager and Meta Pixel. Analytics stack integration for precise event and conversion tracking.
